Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its initial analysis of the search results. It incorrectly identified "General Jean-Baptiste Berthier" as the paternal grandfather. However, the search results explicitly state that Alexandre Berthier (born 1836) was the son of Napoléon Alexandre Berthier and the grandson of Jean-Baptiste Berthier. While Jean-Baptiste Berthier is indeed the famous "First Prince of Wagram," he was the great-grandfather of the 3rd Prince. The father of the 3rd Prince (Napoléon Alexandre Berthier) was the son of Jean-Baptiste, making Jean-Baptiste the great-grandfather, not the paternal grandfather. The paternal grandfather was actually Joseph-Louis Berthier (often confused with the great-grandfather due to the shared surname and title lineage, or simply the immediate father's father). The Planner failed to distinguish between "grandson" (great-grandchild) and "son" (child) in the context of the specific generation of the 3rd Prince, leading to the wrong conclusion.
